# Dr. Supakorn Buasai — Reading Notes & Knowledge Projects

Author: Dr. Supakorn Buasai
Primary language: Thai
Supporting language: English
Website launched: August 2026
Homepage: https://drsupakorn.github.io/
About: https://drsupakorn.github.io/about/

## Purpose

This website began as personal reading notes after retirement and gradually developed into a public collection of essays and knowledge projects.

The primary audience is Thai general readers. English titles, key terms, and concise summaries are provided where useful. Selected sections may become fully bilingual in the future.

The editorial aim is to make complex subjects more accessible while preserving context, accuracy, and respect for different traditions.

## Main collections

- The Best of Dao
  https://drsupakorn.github.io/the-best-of-dao/

- The Best of Buddhism
  https://drsupakorn.github.io/the-best-of-buddhism/

- Mahaparinibbana Sutta
  https://drsupakorn.github.io/the-best-of-buddhism/maha-parinibbana-sutta/

- Buddhist Cosmology
  https://drsupakorn.github.io/buddhist-cosmology/

## Subjects

Buddhism, Daoism, philosophy, health, education, spiritual well-being, public policy, technology, photography, personal development, and lifelong learning.

## Editorial approach

- Accuracy before speed
- Evidence before opinion
- Clear language for general readers
- Respect for different traditions
- Willingness to revise when better evidence becomes available

Modern digital tools, including artificial intelligence, may assist parts of the research and editorial process. Source evaluation, interpretation, verification, and publication decisions remain the author's responsibility.
